# Test fixtures

- `examples/` holds the basic-catalog examples from the A2UI specification
  (<https://github.com/google/A2UI/tree/main/specification/v0_9/catalogs/basic/examples>),
  converted from `{"messages": [...]}` to one message per line.  They are
  licensed under the Apache License 2.0 by their authors.
- `contact_form_example.jsonl` is the spec's contact-form test case and
  `contact_form_doc.jsonl` the stream shown in the protocol document.
- `catalog/` holds one fixture per basic-catalog component, written for
  these tests.
